lead_headline: Restaurant tracking flags 2 new leads Monday — Wapos Cantina Englewood and Mendocino Farms at Union Station both opened, while closure activity quieted across metro.

restaurant.blurb: 2 leads today — Wapos Cantina opened in Rosedale (former El Tepehuan), Mendocino Farms debuted third Denver location at Union Station.

foreclosure.blurb: One $15 million filing scheduled for July 31 auction in Weld County.

liquor.blurb: 8 applications filed Monday after 11-day freeze — Senor Tanuki (Brighton Blvd), Yoshi (17th Ave), Benihana Express (16th St Mall) all pending hotel/restaurant licenses. Mynt tavern at 117 Broadway and Bakery Four beer/wine at Tennyson both already active. Peak Sim Racking Broadway location seeks beer/wine permit, M&A Demoz Quebec Street filed for tasting room, Cruise Room/Starbucks combo targets DIA concourse. Drought officially broken — first applications since July 21.

reputation.blurb: Zero mentions Monday extends weekend drought — 7-day total sits at 6 mentions across 5 sources, down 93% from prior week's 80. Instagram led recent activity with 2 citations, Building Salt Lake covered Alterra ski HQ relocation consideration, Denver Post reported Fire on the Mountain expansion. Week's 0.9 mentions/day average marks lowest sustained rate since tracking launch. If silence holds through Tuesday, August will open at slowest monthly pace on record.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +1 yesterday (7 new, 6 canceled) holds MTD flat at +0 (+0.0/day), 90-day net ticks down to +99. Monday's slim gain follows Saturday's −1 and Friday's +6, capping choppy four-day stretch. Seven-day window now shows +20 net (32 new, 12 canceled) — strongest weekly performance since late July and significant reversal from prior week's +8. Last two weeks demonstrate volatility stabilizing after mid-July chaos (−14 single-day drop on 7/21, +11 rebound on 7/23). Recent pattern suggests August could restore momentum if modest gains persist, but MTD flatline means month needs sustained positivity to meaningfully impact YTD trajectory. Annual net unchanged at +216 (+1.0/day).
